# Vendored visualization libraries

The following unmodified production bundles and their licenses are committed so the page can run without a third-party CDN. Download source: jsDelivr's npm mirror, retrieved 2026-11-10.

| Package | Version | Upstream |
| --- | --- | --- |
| vega | 5.30.0 | https://github.com/vega/vega |
| vega-lite | 5.21.0 | https://github.com/vega/vega-lite |
| vega-embed | 6.26.0 | https://github.com/vega/vega-embed |

Bundle URLs follow `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/PACKAGE@VERSION/build/PACKAGE.min.js`. Each adjacent `PACKAGE.LICENSE` retains its upstream license text. No external font, image or API request is required for the visualization.
